comment: This draft provides a comprehensive and valuable global reference architecture for digital public infrastructure for health (DPI-H). However, overlapping content can be observed between the governance module and the data governance module in the current text. Without clear guidance on streamlining duplicated content, implementing practitioners may face confusion and reduced operational efficiency during national-level localization and deployment. Adding targeted reminders for content simplification will significantly improve the practical usability of the guidance for global implementers.
